Jon (CSM): Quick capture from the past three days of customer asks. Please drop one-line entries — tag with BUCKET: ACCOUNT_HEALTH / ONBOARDING_FRICTION / RENEWAL_RISK / FEATURE_REQUEST / ENABLEMENT — I'll stitch into the weekly digest.

Aisha (CS Ops): ACCOUNT_HEALTH: NovaPayments wants per-customer spend alerts at 70% of committed reserved capacity. Right now only org-level alerts; they want tenant granularity.

Ethan (PM): FEATURE_REQUEST: trial users asking for a "recommended model" toggle in the console that shows the best tradeoff for cost vs P95 latency for a given prompt length.

Rosa (Support): ONBOARDING_FRICTION: two customers reported SSO missing SCIM group sync option which blocks onboarding for >50 seats. Workaround is manual invite — slow.

Vik (AE): RENEWAL_RISK: Beacon Analytics noted recurring false-positive rate increase in their quality regression alerts after last model swap; they're asking for rollback + a post-mortem feed-in to avoid churn. High priority.

Jon (CSM): ENABLEMENT: Sales asks for a short "migration checklist" doc for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated (networking, key rotation, perf validation). Keep it under 2 pages.

Aisha (CS Ops): FEATURE_REQUEST: customers want webhook events for model-rollout changes and canary promotions so they can automate smoke-tests.

Rosa (Support): VERBATIM: [beacon-2026-03-15-call] "We lost confidence after the last rollout; we need predictable rollback windows and visibility into what changed."

Vik (AE): VERBATIM: [novapay-2026-03-16-email] "We get a single invoice line for the org; we need per-team breakout or we'll need a custom billing export."

Ethan (PM): Voting note — please react :+1: for high-impact, :thinking_face: for needs more context, :white_check_mark: if you can take ownership. I'll surface top 5 for the sprint planning meeting.

clip-bot: Reminder: paste links to call clips as single-line items (e.g., https://clips.redwood/beacon-0315).

Aisha (CS Ops): I'll add NovaPayments and Beacon rows to the feedback tracker and tag owners. Also pinging product-security for SCIM gap.

Jon (CSM): Assignments proposed: NovaPayments alerts -> @Aisha, SCIM + SSO sync -> @Rosa to own triage with sec, webhook events -> @Ethan, migration checklist -> @Jon. Speak up if conflict.

Ethan (PM): Noted. I'll scope webhook events and the "recommended model" UX spike; ETA for spike doc: 1 week.

Rosa (Support): I'll collect exact SCIM requirements from the two impacted customers and add to tracker.

Jon (CSM): Thanks team — I'll close when tracker rows have owners and ETA. If you add new items later, prefix with the bucket tag. :sparkles:
